FRENCH — MOCK EXAM #6
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: FRENCH
TIME ALLOWED: 90 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 80
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. What does 'l'enfant' mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. the brother
   B. the family
   C. the child
   D. the baby

2. What does 'le bébé' mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. the boy
   B. the mother
   C. the baby
   D. the child

3. Which month is 'janvier'? (1 mark)
   A. December
   B. January
   C. July
   D. June

4. What number is 'trente et un' in French? (1 mark)
   A. 5
   B. 31
   C. 4
   D. 17

5. What does 'un anniversaire' mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. a present
   B. a song
   C. a cake
   D. a birthday

6. What does 'le maïs' mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. juice
   B. the carrot
   C. chips
   D. maize

7. What does 'le riz' mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. juice
   B. health
   C. rice
   D. maize

8. What does 'le cou' mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. the neck
   B. the leg
   C. the nose
   D. the hair

9. What does 'Il y a du vent.' mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. It is windy.
   B. The weather is nice.
   C. It is freezing.
   D. It is hot.

10. How do you say 'What is the weather like?' in French? (1 mark)
   A. Quel temps fait-il ?
   B. Demain, il fait beau.
   C. Il y a des nuages.
   D. Il fait froid.

11. What does 'une inondation' mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. the weather
   B. the storm
   C. a flood
   D. the snow

12. Read: Amina: Bonjour, Kamau ! Kamau: Salut, Amina ! Ça va ? Amina: Oui, ça va bien, merci. Question: Who says Ça va ? (1 mark)
   A. Kamau
   B. the teacher
   C. nobody
   D. Amina

13. What does 'Le samedi, j'aide ma mère.' mean? (1 mark)
   A. On Thursday, I sing.
   B. Tomorrow it is Thursday.
   C. On Saturday, I help my mother.
   D. On Friday, I dance.

14. What does 'Le samedi, je joue.' mean? (1 mark)
   A. On Saturday, I play.
   B. What day is it today?
   C. On Saturday, I help my mother.
   D. On Thursday, I sing.

15. Read: Aujourd'hui, c'est le 12 mai. C'est l'anniversaire d'Amina. Elle a dix ans. Il y a un gâteau et dix bougies. Question: Whose birthday is it? (1 mark)
   A. the teacher's
   B. Amina's
   C. Njeri's
   D. Kamau's

16. Which little word goes with 'thé' (the tea)? (1 mark)
   A. la
   B. les
   C. le
   D. l'

17. Fill in: Je ______ un jus. (I drink) (1 mark)
   A. suis
   B. bois
   C. aime
   D. mange

18. Read: Quand il y a un orage, je reste dans la maison. Je ne vais pas sous un grand arbre. Quand il fait très chaud, je bois de l'eau. Question: What does the speaker drink when it is very hot? (1 mark)
   A. juice
   B. water
   C. milk
   D. tea

19. How do you say 'Where is ... ?' in French? (1 mark)
   A. le salon
   B. Où est ... ?
   C. derrière
   D. le livre

20. How do you say 'the bag' in French? (1 mark)
   A. la cuisine
   B. la douche
   C. la salle de bain
   D. le sac

21. How do you say 'in front of' in French? (1 mark)
   A. derrière
   B. dans
   C. sur
   D. devant

22. How do you say 'tomorrow' in French? (1 mark)
   A. je joue
   B. aujourd'hui
   C. demain
   D. je danse

23. How do you say the month 'December' in French? (1 mark)
   A. avril
   B. mars
   C. décembre
   D. octobre

24. How do you write the number 2 in French? (1 mark)
   A. vingt-cinq
   B. neuf
   C. deux
   D. onze

25. How do you say 'the carrot' in French? (1 mark)
   A. le pain
   B. l'orange
   C. le poulet
   D. la carotte

26. How do you say 'the banana' in French? (1 mark)
   A. les légumes
   B. la banane
   C. le thé
   D. le fromage

27. How do you say 'chips' in French? (1 mark)
   A. les frites
   B. les légumes
   C. les fruits
   D. le lait

28. How do you say 'the mouth' in French? (1 mark)
   A. le pied
   B. la bouche
   C. la jambe
   D. la dent

29. How do you say 'the head' in French? (1 mark)
   A. la jambe
   B. la dent
   C. l'oreille
   D. la tête

30. How do you say 'the rug' in French? (1 mark)
   A. le tapis
   B. le magasin
   C. la clé
   D. le jardin

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
31. Translate into English: 'La porte est à côté de la fenêtre.' (4 marks) (4 marks)

32. Translate into English: 'Comment tu t'appelles ?' (3 marks) (3 marks)

33. Translate into English: 'Aujourd'hui, c'est lundi.' (2 marks) (2 marks)

34. Write four sentences in French about your family. Use mon or ma correctly. (4 marks) (4 marks)

35. Translate into English: 'Bonjour, Amina !' (2 marks) (2 marks)

36. Translate into English: 'Le ballon est derrière la porte.' (3 marks) (3 marks)

37. Translate into French: 'Pleased to meet you!' (2 marks) (2 marks)

38. Translate into English: 'Elle a les cheveux noirs.' (3 marks) (3 marks)

39. Translate into English: 'Il neige.' (2 marks) (2 marks)

40. Translate into French: 'In the morning, I eat bread.' (3 marks) (3 marks)

41. Translate into English: 'C'est le bébé.' (2 marks) (2 marks)

42. Translate into English: 'Ce sont des oranges.' (3 marks) (3 marks)

43. Complete the dialogue with words from the bank: ______ ! Je ______ Amina. Et toi ? (bank: Bonjour, m'appelle) (2 marks) (2 marks)

44. Translate into English: 'Le samedi, j'aide ma mère.' (3 marks) (3 marks)

45. Name the four French accents you have learned and give an example word for each. (4 marks) (4 marks)

46. Translate into French: 'How do you spell it?' (3 marks) (3 marks)

47. Translate into French: 'They are mangoes.' (3 marks) (3 marks)

48. Translate into English: 'J'aime le lait.' (2 marks) (2 marks)

FRENCH — MOCK EXAM #6 · MARKING SCHEME

SECTION A
----
1. C — the child
   l'enfant means the child.

2. C — the baby
   le bébé means the baby.

3. B — January
   janvier means January.

4. B — 31
   trente et un means 31.

5. D — a birthday
   un anniversaire means a birthday.

6. D — maize
   le maïs means maize.

7. C — rice
   le riz means rice.

8. A — the neck
   le cou means the neck.

9. A — It is windy.
   Il y a du vent. means It is windy..

10. A — Quel temps fait-il ?
   What is the weather like? in French is Quel temps fait-il ?

11. C — a flood
   une inondation means a flood.

12. A — Kamau
   Kamau asks Ça va ? in his second line.

13. C — On Saturday, I help my mother.
   Le samedi, j'aide ma mère. means On Saturday, I help my mother.

14. A — On Saturday, I play.
   Le samedi, je joue. means On Saturday, I play.

15. B — Amina's
   C'est l'anniversaire d'Amina.

16. C — le
   thé is masculine, so we say le thé.

17. B — bois
   Je bois means I drink.

18. B — water
   Je bois de l'eau.

19. B — Où est ... ?

26. B — la banane
   the banana in French is la banane.
